svg.title: Known-best packing of 153 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=153 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete algebraic-number-field Witness/v2 of PR 574 at 4c319c2, read exactly from a release asset whose size and SHA-256 a manifest of that commit pins; no upstream byte is retained. Decided on one exact route, sqpack exact_verify over the witness's field; no second route over a number field is maintained. Finite construction feasibility only; an exact certificate of a construction others found, with no novelty, priority, local minimum, rigidity or global optimality claim.
